spans.s:
pakṣá, m.
 —1. wing, 93^2;
 —2. side, of a
door or of the hair of the head;
 —3. half,
esp. of a lunar month, 27^1, 57^19, cf. kṛṣṇa-,
śukla-; --4. side, i. e. party, 37^18.

pakṣín, a. winged, 92^19; as m. bird, 2^23.
[pakṣa.]

pakṣimṛgatā, f. condition of bird or
of beast. [fr. pakṣin + mṛga: 1237,
1252.]

pakṣi-śāvaka, m. young of a bird;
birdling. [pakṣin.]

pā́ka, a.
 —1. of a calf, young;
 —2. simple.
 [lit. ‘sucking,’ √1pā, ‘drink.’]

pāka-dūrvā́, f. young millet-grass.
[pā́ka + dū́rvā: acct, 1280^2.]
